public_rationale: The hypothetical arithmetic is correct: 11 million divided by 300 million is 3.67%. A CFO interview also supports the narrower statement that subscriptions dominated revenue in October 2024. However, it does not establish the full-year revenue mix selected for the ongoing financial assertion. The compound claim therefore remains unresolved under that contract. This is not evidence that Zitron's arithmetic or contemporary revenue-share description was wrong.
limitations: A reading confined to the cited historical subscriber figure and contemporary revenue mix is supported.
The numerical result does not establish ChatGPT's actual conversion rate at publication.
The characterization of the rate as poor is subjective.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If ChatGPT had 300 million monthly active users, that would mean a conversion rate to paying users of under 4%, which he calls pretty piss-poor, especially since subscription revenue makes up the majority of OpenAI's revenue.

statement.excerpt: 300 million monthly active users would mean a conversion rate of less than 4%, which is pretty piss-poor, especially as subscription revenue for ChatGPT Plus (and other monthly subscriptions) makes up the majority of OpenAI's revenue.

from_speaker: subscription revenue for ChatGPT Plus (and other monthly subscriptions)
our_interpretation: The numerical statement is hypothetical arithmetic using the surrounding passage's rounded 11 million paying subscribers. It does not assert that monthly active users actually numbered 300 million.
The arithmetic is assessed separately from the ongoing revenue-share assertion.
For the revenue assertion, 2024 is the latest completed calendar year before publication. This period is an evaluator choice because Zitron supplies no revenue accounting period.
Majority means more than half of revenue. The description of the rate as poor is an opinion and is not scored.
The financial claim is treated as an estimate based on the press reporting invoked in the passage.
criteria.support_condition: The stipulated calculation is below 4%, and matching estimates of realized 2024 revenue show subscriptions contributing more than half.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The stipulated calculation is at least 4%, or matching estimates show subscriptions contributed no more than half of realized 2024 revenue.
